08 Who it's for

For anyone stuck on the flare.

01

Beginner to intermediate breakers

  • See what your body does in each phase
  • Know which muscles to train
  • Spot what you need to work on
02

Street workout and gymnastics enthusiasts

  • Break down the technique
  • Follow a progressive training path
03

Coaches and breaking studios

  • Visual tools for teaching are planned.

The Thomas flare is a breaking and gymnastics move where you alternate hand support as your legs circle your body. FlareLab breaks one full rotation into eight phases. You can pause the 3D model and rotate it to see each hand placement and weight shift from different angles. The muscle map highlights the muscles involved at each phase. Three levels of drills help beginners build strength, mobility, and support. You can also ask the AI coach about a phase or how to practice it.

09 FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Q1Where can I download it?
Search for FlareLab or 托马斯训练助手 on the App Store and Google Play, or try the web app.
Q2Is it free?
Basic movement breakdowns and some training are free. Flare Premium includes the AI coach, custom training plans, and other features. See the in-app store for subscription terms.
Q3Can I start as a complete beginner?
Yes. The app breaks the flare into phases and offers three levels of drills, starting with basic strength, mobility, and support.
Q4How is this different from learning from a video?
Pause and rotate the 3D model to inspect each phase from any angle, with the active muscles highlighted for that phase. You can also ask the AI coach a question at any point.
Q5Does it need an internet connection?
The built-in 3D breakdown works offline. Exercise videos need to download on first use, and the online AI coach needs a connection.
